name: approach-target
title: Approach a manipulation target
description: Park the base where the right arm has a collision-free IK solution at the target's reach pose: 10 cm above an object or support, the handle pre-grasp of a door or drawer, 8 cm in front of a button.
use_when: Right before a contact action on one specific target.

not_to_be_confused_with.navigate: navigate goes to a region; approach verifies arm IK for one target.

target.description: The object, support, handle-bearing part or button to reach.

pass_by.description: Optional base waypoint: reach toward the target while driving past it.

base_pose.description: Base pose at which reachability was verified.

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: reachable
postconditions.meaning: From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: reachable
checks.meaning: From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_paths.note: Extend the arm toward the reach pose while the base follows the given waypoint.

previous.when: a manipulation target is on the destination
the target was just out of reach
the observed target will be manipulated
the target is now in front of the arm

next.when: the target is an object to grasp
the target is a door or drawer

fallback.when: no base pose near the current one reaches the target
the target is just beyond the arm envelope
fallback.reason: Waist pitch adds forward reach from the same base pose.

fallback.when: the object sits too deep on its support
fallback.reason: Dragging the object to the front makes it reachable.

fallback_for.when: no grasp is reachable from base poses near the current one
the receptacle is out of reach
no base pose reaches behind the object
the handle is out of reach

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
typical: no base pose reaches the target

includes: base pose search with IK + collision checks
